description: Queues a new run of an eval — inference over the dataset, then LLM-judge scoring. THE VERIFY STEP of the improvement loop: after an approved workbench_flows_edit_text, run the eval again and report the score delta vs the previous run. Runs take a while — but you're brought back into THIS conversation automatically with the scores the moment it finishes, so tell the user it's queued and that you'll follow up here; never poll or ask them to check back. Costs workspace LLM budget, so it sits behind the approval gate: may return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation envelope.

label.description: Short label for the run, e.g. 'after refund-policy fix'.

scenarioId.description: Run as this scenario instead of the eval's own (one of the flow's, from workbench_flows_scenarios_list); null runs with none. Omit to use the eval's. Running the same eval as two scenarios compares how the flow does for each person.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: caliper_evals_run
title: Run a Caliper eval
